purpose: Pass7 focused same-font vowel contour challenge at six remaining Maccabees notes; source-specific approved proposals, not whole-book approval.
canonicalApplicationState: No canonical edits by this report author; root applies approved proposals separately. Both canonical books still match pass7 baseline at creation.
sourcePolicy: Only freshly extracted original primary/companion embedded pixels, native crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements. No OCR, grammar-based points, normalization, filtering, reconstructed marks or other translations. Complete shallow bar/deep stem/multiple-point geometry is compared with local source-font controls; connected or ragged ink alone does not determine unreadability.
scope: Six selected annotations in annotated chapters only. The1MA8:28 comparison shares physical primary140 with annotated9:1; it is a font control on an already reviewed physical page, not an unrelated chapter export. No new PSIK exports were created or used.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וּשְׁאָר־הַפָּרָשִׁים הֶעֱמִידוּ מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה מַפְחִידִים וּמְכסִּים בִּגְדוּדִים׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וּשְׁאָר־הַפָּרָשִׁים הֶעֱמִידוּ מִזֶּה וּמִזֶּה מִשְּׁנֵי עֶבְרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה מַפְחִידִים וּמְכַסִּים בִּגְדוּדִים׃
decisions.finding: The companion kaf vowel is a continuous broad shallow bar with short end lugs. Same-page הַ article and מַ in מַפְחִידִים show the same shallow patah contour, while אָ in וּשְׁאָר has a long central qamats stem and זֶ in מִזֶּה has three separately placed segol stamps. The target lacks those deeper dot/stem structures; the shallow bar texture matches patah. Primary is saturated and does not itself distinguish the point.

independentApproval.basis: All four approved target contours, local positive/counter controls and full words were independently viewed before approval.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וַיִּשְׁמַע דְמִטְרִיוֹס כִּי־נָפַל נִיקָנוֹר וְחֵילוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיּוֹסֶף לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־בּקְחִידֵס וְאֶת־אַלְקִימוֹס שֵׁנִית לְאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־הַקֶּרֶן הַיְמָנִית אִתָּם׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וַיִּשְׁמַע דְמִטְרִיוֹס כִּי־נָפַל נִיקָנוֹר וְחֵילוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה וַיּוֹסֶף לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת־בַּקְחִידֵס וְאֶת־אַלְקִימוֹס שֵׁנִית לְאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־הַקֶּרֶן הַיְמָנִית אִתָּם׃
decisions.finding: The companion bet vowel is a broad continuous shallow bar with two small bottom lobes and a central lower void. Same-unit בַּ in בַּמִּלְחָמָה has a similarly ragged but shallow joined patah bar. The second mem in that control word has a long qamats stem; the adjacent אֶת supplies three separated segol stamps. Those different structures are absent from the target bar. Primary is saturated. Patah is inserted before the existing dagesh; no normalization is applied to other marks.

independentApproval.basis: All four approved target contours, local positive/counter controls and full words were independently viewed before approval.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וַיָּמָת אַלְקִימוֹס בָּעֵת הַהִיא בְּרגְזָה גְדוֹלָה׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וַיָּמָת אַלְקִימוֹס בָּעֵת הַהִיא בְּרָגְזָה גְדוֹלָה׃
decisions.finding: The resh has a broad flat bar plus a distinct deep central foot/ring. Same-word זָ has the same bar-plus-deep-separated-foot qamats structure. Same-page אַ in אַלְקִימוֹס has only shallow bar lugs; אֶת has three distinct segol stamps. Adjacent bet sheva is a vertical pair, not the resh bar/foot. Target is qamats, not patah or a bare ragged bar.

independentApproval.basis: All four approved target contours, local positive/counter controls and full words were independently viewed before approval.

decisions.unitTextBefore: אָז יָקָם שִׁמְעוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּעַד עַמּוֹ וַיּוֹצֵא רְכוּשׁ רַב מֵאֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הוֹצִיא וַיַּחֲמשׁ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל מֵעַמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שָׂכָר׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: אָז יָקָם שִׁמְעוֹן וַיִּלָּחֶם בְּעַד עַמּוֹ וַיּוֹצֵא רְכוּשׁ רַב מֵאֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הוֹצִיא וַיַּחֲמשׁ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הַחַיִל מֵעַמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שָׂכָר׃
decisions.finding: No lower point is discriminable. Expanded native head view includes the complete mem shoulder, the neighboring shin and its existing shin dot. The raised mem shoulder matches ordinary mem in same-line מֵעַמּוֹ; the separate upper dot belongs to the already pointed shin. No extra holam or absent vowel is inferred. Primary is saturated; retain the original uncertainty.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וְאֶת־יָפוֹ בִּצֵּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַיָּם וְאֶת־גֶּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־גְּבוּל אַשְׁדּוֹד אֲשֶׁר יָשְׁבוּ הָאוֹיְבִים לְפָנִים שָׁם וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם יְהוּדִים וְאֶת כָּל־הַצֹּרֶךְ לְתקֵּן אוֹתָן שָׁם בְּתוֹכָן׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וְאֶת־יָפוֹ בִּצֵּר אֲשֶׁר עַל־הַיָּם וְאֶת־גֶּזֶר אֲשֶׁר עַל־גְּבוּל אַשְׁדּוֹד אֲשֶׁר יָשְׁבוּ הָאוֹיְבִים לְפָנִים שָׁם וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם יְהוּדִים וְאֶת כָּל־הַצֹּרֶךְ לְתַקֵּן אוֹתָן שָׁם בְּתוֹכָן׃
decisions.finding: The target tav carries a broad horizontal bar with only a one-pixel central lower lug. Same-page הַ in הַצֹּרֶךְ has a shallow flat patah bar. Same-row same-letter תָ in אוֹתָן has a long central qamats stem. The complete contour distinguishes the shallow patah bar from that deep stem; minor lower lugs do not change the vowel class.

independentApproval.basis: All four approved target contours, local positive/counter controls and full words were independently viewed before approval.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וְהוּא לֹא חָשַׁב דָּבָר עַל־כֹּחַ אֱלֹהִים כִּי מִשְׁעָן הָיָה מֵרִבבוֹת אִישׁ רַגְלִי וּמֵאַלְפֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וּמִשְּׁמוֹנִים הַפִּילִים׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וְהוּא לֹא חָשַׁב דָּבָר עַל־כֹּחַ אֱלֹהִים כִּי מִשְׁעָן הָיָה מֵרִבבוֹת אִישׁ רַגְלִי וּמֵאַלְפֵי הַפָּרָשִׁים וּמִשְּׁמוֹנִים הַפִּילִים׃
decisions.finding: The companion point is compound-shaped: compact left L/block plus a separate right vertical pair. Same-page עֲ in לַעֲשׂוֹת has a long flat left patah bar with a right pair; same-font אֳ in אֳנִיּוֹת has a left bar and deep stem with a right pair. The target compact left cluster does not uniquely preserve either form. Same-word mem tsere is a separate horizontal pair. Primary merges point and foot. Retain without supplying a hataf class.
